title: Filter a dashboard by a label

blocks.content: Use a filter variable on your current dashboard to narrow supported queries by a label. Add a filter, inspect the results, and remove only the filter you added.

Find the first filter control on this dashboard. Open its label list, note an unused label without selecting it, then close the list. If this control is missing, open a dashboard with a filter variable.
blocks.tooltip: Use an available label that is not already applied.
blocks.hint: Open a dashboard with a filter variable.

blocks.prompt: Enter an available label from the highlighted control’s list that is not already applied on this dashboard.
blocks.validationMessage: Use a label starting with a letter or underscore, followed by letters, numbers, or underscores.

blocks.content: Add an equals filter using the first available value for your chosen label:
Add a filter for your chosen label with **=** and the first available value. Select **Run 2 steps** to apply it.

steps.reftarget: body:not(:has([aria-label='Edit filter with key {{filterLabel}}'])) {grafana:pages.Dashboard.SubMenu.submenuItem}:has(input[placeholder='+ label = value']):nth-match(1) input[placeholder='+ label = value']
steps.description: Type your chosen label and choose **=**.
steps.tooltip: Choose an available label that is not already applied.

steps.description: Choose the first available value for this label.
steps.tooltip: Type to search when the list is long.

blocks.content: Your filter is now applied. Inspect panels using this variable’s data source to see how supported queries respond.
blocks.tooltip: Click the pill to change its operator or value.

blocks.content: You filtered supported queries by a label.
Remove only the filter you added for your chosen label.
blocks.tooltip: Other filters and groupings remain in place.

blocks.content: You restored the previous filtering. Filters are stored in the URL, so you can share a filtered view by sharing its link.
